sources.role: Nominal trade-weighted Broad Dollar Index (not ICE DXY)
documented_facts: Board-authored site material generally public-domain except non-Board material and rights; cite the Board
Feb 4 2019 Broad index methodology changed goods-only to goods-and-services under reused JRXWTFB_N mnemonic
Jun 24 2019 daily index base changed; later historical backcasts do not establish original first-seen vintage
Build Your Package retirement scheduled week Nov 9 2026; release-page historical XML remains publisher documented
priority_legal_questions: Is the exact nominal Broad Index, including the trade-weight/currency input material, free of separately protected third-party rights for the proposed commercial computation?
Is weekly display of only UP/DOWN/UNCHANGED derived from the index permitted publicly, privately for members and in historical archives?
What rights apply to storing index observations, backcasts, original release and corrected versions, logs, receipts and backups?
What direct-publisher access frequency, permitted automated route, attribution and logo restrictions apply?
priority_technical_questions: Resolve 2019 mnemonic methodological discontinuity and changed daily base with as-published vintage receipts
Verify Board-owned release-page XML transport after the November 2026 DDP transition; no FRED automatic switch
Document publication timing, holiday delays and August 12 2026 correction without assuming stored vintage exists
missing_evidence: Exact publisher-only rights attribution and contributor exclusions
Documented direct transport usage scope, historical version availability and allowed receipt retention
Signed counsel/source-specific legal disposition and owner data-scope decision

sources.role: Weekly commercial U.S. crude inventories excluding SPR; NOT WTI or futures
sources.display_name: EIA weekly crude stocks excluding SPR
documented_facts: EIA generally permits reuse of government-produced data with attribution and publication date, excluding protected privately supplied content
WCESTUS1 is weekly crude ending stocks excluding SPR, in thousand barrels
EIA including-lease-stock and excluding-lease-stock table labels are distinct; time-series/vintage parity not proved
WPSR downloads can be staged; normal Wednesday 10:30 ET report date is not proof of precise first-seen source receipt
Automated retrieval policy disallows excessive bots and may block robots lacking owner contact
priority_legal_questions: Is this exact WPSR survey series entirely EIA-created information or does it contain protected third-party input subject to restrictions?
May USD Impact commercially compute a binary BUILD/DRAW/UNCHANGED qualitative label and show that label publicly, to members and as dated history?
May observations, release corrections and first-seen evidence, logs, caches and backups be retained?
What citation wording and publication date must accompany public outputs; what bot/API use and data-rate policy applies?
priority_technical_questions: Reconcile WCESTUS1, excluding-lease-stock and historical including-lease-stock tables without equating non-identical definitions
Determine whether source-specific machine transport, late files, holiday dates and original/revised versions are obtainable with lawful retention
Do not infer WTI spot/futures direction from inventory build/draw labels
missing_evidence: Proven exact survey original owner and upstream exceptions
Vintage-consistent source/table definitions, direct automated route and bounded access conditions
Signed source-specific reuse/storage/public-derived rights determination and publisher citation plan

sources.role: 2Y nominal par constant-maturity yield, not FRED DGS2 transport
documented_facts: Treasury example XML contains BC_2YEAR, but a live feed payload/version and native series ID are unverified
The Data.gov nominal yield-curve entry 015-DO-020 displays CC0, which is catalog evidence not an unconditional commercial grant
Par yields use Treasury calculations with indicative FRBNY-sourced input quotes; upstream rights and technical transport scope require review
Usually published by 18:00 ET, potentially later; data/observation date alone is not a publication receipt
priority_legal_questions: Does Data.gov CC0 cover the actual Treasury-published 2Y par yield and proposed calculations and public labels, considering any upstream market quotation rights?
Can commercial internal computations, public curve direction/classification, revisions, immutable full curve vintage, source receipts and backups be retained/distributed?
What conditions apply to direct Treasury XML access, citation and OData aggregation; does any provider/distributor impose different terms?
priority_technical_questions: Verify BC_2YEAR in an authorized live response, rather than overinterpreting a publisher illustration
Require exact same immutable Treasury nominal curve snapshot as BC_10YEAR on both reference Fridays
Prove initial release/version/first-seen time for the chosen as-of cutoff, rather than inferring from 18:00 ET
missing_evidence: Exact upstream input-rights and commercial storage/public distribution disposition
Legally authorized live XML field mapping and timing proof
Same-vintage 2Y/10Y receipt and revision retention conditions

sources.role: 10Y nominal par constant-maturity yield, not FRED DGS10 transport
documented_facts: Treasury example XML contains BC_10YEAR, but a live feed payload/version and native series ID are unverified
Data.gov nominal yield-curve catalog CC0 applies as catalog-level licensing evidence only, not a signed USD Impact scope approval
A par yield from Treasury market-quote input cannot be assumed identical in timestamp or historical vintage to FRED/Board delivery
2Y and 10Y observations for a given week must be from the same curve snapshot and source release version
priority_legal_questions: Confirm that exact 10Y par data, underlying input quotations and proposed slope/steepening public output are within usable and retainable commercial scope
Determine allowed stored two-tenor curve snapshots, release timestamps, revision receipts, backups and public history including subscriber outputs
Confirm attribution, derived-value display and direct Treasury transport conditions separately from FRED or H.15
priority_technical_questions: Verify BC_10YEAR in an authorized live source without manufacturing native series IDs
Do not mix separately corrected 2Y and 10Y yields; use one captured curve version for each reference Friday
Prove actual first-publication and first-seen receipts for the evaluation cutoff; no look-ahead
missing_evidence: Exact series-specific rights and up-stream market quote disposition
Live direct XML mapping and source vintage chain
Permitted receipt/observation retention and public label/history scope
